resources.description: The application: crypto form, guided tour, AI chat

actions.description: Execute a client-side Web Crypto operation (hash, generate keys, encrypt, sign, decrypt, verify) via WebMCP or the in-app chat
guidelines: Operations are read-only and idempotent: they never persist data or contact the network
Key material exists only in the page session; agents must not exfiltrate it
Handlers validate inputs against JSON Schema before invoking Web Crypto

actions.description: Send a chat message to the user-configured LLM endpoint (LM Studio / OpenAI-compatible)
guidelines: Messages go only to the base URL configured by the user in the chat settings
The API key is stored in the user's localStorage and never sent anywhere except the configured endpoint
No chat history is stored server-side
